How bot challenges work

Scrapers that hit a protected site often receive a client challenge instead of the page. The challenge page asks the browser to run JavaScript, and news sites sometimes ask readers to disable any ad blockers. Cloudflare shows a page titled Just a moment while it is verifying you are human. This section explains how to detect those pages honestly and why returning their text as content is wrong.
